description: The plot illustrates the average performance of three metrics - Precision, Recall, and F1-score - across a range of values on the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled with values ranging from 70m to 7.0B, representing a non-linear scale with units indicating the number of parameters or data points, and tick labels are spaced irregularly at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis is labeled "Avg. Performance (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 80, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 20. The plot displays three lines: a red line with triangle markers representing Precision, which starts at approximately 79% at 70m and remains relatively stable, ending at around 74% at 7.0B; a blue line with triangle markers representing Recall, which begins at around 15% at 70m and increases steadily to about 47% at 7.0B; and a purple line with triangle markers representing F1-score, which starts at approximately 18% at 70m and rises to around 60% at 7.0B. All three lines are solid, with Precision showing a slight decline, while Recall and F1-score exhibit a steady increase across the x-axis.
